In the emergency management of over- dosage with cocaine the general aims are to establish adequate ventilation and support the circulation. If oral ingestion of a large amount is suspected the stomach should be emptied and activat- ed charcoal given.1 A tourniquet may be applied to limit absorp- tion if the drug was injected.
